
## 1. Frontal pole - Leave-one-out analysis

```{r}
loo_results <- data.frame()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(thickness_z))) {
  data_i <- thickness_z[-i, ]
  model_i <- lm(lh_frontalpole_thickness ~ group, data = data_i)
  summ_i <- summary(model_i)
  d_i <- cohen.d(data_i$lh_frontalpole_thickness[data_i$group == "Patient"],
                  data_i$lh_frontalpole_thickness[data_i$group == "HC"],
                  hedges.correction = FALSE)

  loo_results <- rbind(loo_results, data.frame(
    excluded_id = thickness_z$SubjectID[i],
    Beta        = summ_i$coefficients["groupPatient", "Estimate"],
    p_value     = summ_i$coefficients["groupPatient", "Pr(>|t|)"],
    d           = as.numeric(d_i$estimate)
  ))
}

range(loo_results$p_value)
range(loo_results$d)
sum(loo_results$p_value < 0.05)
nrow(loo_results)
```

## 2. Frontal pole - Violin plot

```{r}
FrontalPole_plot <- ggplot(thickness_z, aes(x = group, y = lh_frontalpole_thickness, fill = group)) +
  # violin (distribution shape)
  geom_violin(width = 0.8, alpha = 0.5, colour = NA, trim = FALSE) +

  # boxplot (summary stats)
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, colour = "black", alpha = 0.8) +

  # individual points, jittered
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.6, shape = 21,
              colour = "black", stroke = 0.2) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HC" = "#a2c8e1", "Patient" = "#05326c")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Patient", "HC"), labels = c("HC" = "Control", "Patient" = "Study")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Left frontal pole thickness (z-score)", fill = "Group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black")
  )
FrontalPole_plot
```

## 3. Platinum findings - Leave-one-out analysis

```{r}
chemo <- read_xlsx("/Users/robcolaes/Desktop/PhD/2_CIP/Analyses/3_NormativeModelling/1_RedCap/Data_clean/Chemo_regimen/CT.xlsx")
chemo <- chemo[,c(2,3,8:13,18)]
chemo$Platinum <- as.factor(chemo$Platinum)
chemo$Taxanen <- as.factor(chemo$Taxanen)
chemo$Cyclophosphamide <- as.factor(chemo$Cyclophosphamide)
chemo$Anthracyclines <- as.factor(chemo$Anthracyclines)
chemo <- chemo[chemo$SubjectID!="C90",] #exclusion
```

```{r}
thickness_z_chemo <- merge(thickness_z,chemo,by="SubjectID",all.y = TRUE)
```

```{r}
platinum_ids <- which(thickness_z_chemo$Platinum=="1")

vars <- c("lh_frontalpole_thickness","lh_lateralorbitofrontal_thickness")

Chemo_Platinum_LOO <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
  
  loo_results <- lapply(platinum_ids, function(id) {
    
    data_loo <- thickness_z_chemo[-id, ]
    
    formula <- as.formula(paste0(v, " ~ Platinum"))
    model <- lm(formula, data = data_loo)
    summ <- summary(model)
    
    beta   <- summ$coefficients["Platinum1", "Estimate"]
    se     <- summ$coefficients["Platinum1", "Std. Error"]
    t      <- summ$coefficients["Platinum1", "t value"]
    p      <- summ$coefficients["Platinum1", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    df_res <- model$df.residual
    
    ci_beta <- confint(model)["Platinum1", ]
    
    d_res <- t_to_d(t, df_error = df_res, ci = 0.95)
    
    data.frame(
      Variable       = v,
      Excluded_ID    = id,
      Beta           = beta,
      CI_lower       = ci_beta[1],
      CI_upper       = ci_beta[2],
      SE             = se,
      t_value        = t,
      P_value        = p,
      Cohens_d       = d_res$d,
      d_CI_lower     = d_res$CI_low,
      d_CI_upper     = d_res$CI_high
    )
  })
  
  do.call(rbind, loo_results)
})

Chemo_Platinum_LOO_df <- do.call(rbind, Chemo_Platinum_LOO)
Chemo_Platinum_LOO_df
```

```{r}
for (v in unique(Chemo_Platinum_LOO_df$Variable)) {
  cat("\nVariable:", v, "\n")
  sub <- Chemo_Platinum_LOO_df[Chemo_Platinum_LOO_df$Variable == v, ]
  print(range(sub$P_value))
  print(range(sub$Cohens_d))
  print(sum(sub$P_value < 0.05))
  print(nrow(sub))
}
```
